I've diagnosed the issue. Looking at [MediaViewerModalContent.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModalContent.tsx), the symptoms match a known FlashList v2 problem: **`FlashList` + `horizontal` + `inverted` + `pagingEnabled` + dynamically growing data**. The list's internal content size doesn't recompute when new pages are appended, so even though `mediaItems` grows (your `console.log` confirms this), the list stays pegged to the original 2 pages (seed image + edge).

The fix is to swap `FlashList` → `FlatList`, which handles this combo reliably. `FlatList` needs `getItemLayout` to make `initialScrollIndex`/`scrollToIndex` work without measurement. I'll also drop the stray debug log.

**Summary of the fix ([MediaViewerModalContent.tsx:21-28,56,269-287](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModalContent.tsx#L21-L287)):**

- Swapped `FlashList` → `FlatList` (from `react-native`).
- Added `getItemLayout` so the list has fixed-width pages and `initialScrollIndex` / `scrollToIndex` land correctly without measurement.
- Everything else (remount key, viewable-items handler, edge sentinel, pagination trigger) kept as-is.

**Root cause:** `@shopify/flash-list@2.3.0` with `horizontal` + `inverted` + `pagingEnabled` + data that grows after mount doesn't recompute its content size. That's why `mediaItems` grew (your `console.log` confirmed it) but the pager stayed pegged to the seeded image + edge — there was no scrollable content beyond that. `FlatList` handles this combination reliably.
